fusions.name: Dragging Links
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted chain that deals 5 damage to the first enemy it meets, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of the damage. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave its target [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hand Over Hand
fusions.desc: Hauls you along a chain to a target up to 7 tiles away, then deals 14 damage, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sea Anchor
fusions.desc: Drops an anchor ahead of you on 6 tiles of chain. For 7 seconds it drags every enemy near it inward, and anything it catches moves 30% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: No Link Slips
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them. You also regenerate 0.5 health a second.
